{{Quote|What's her name?''"<br />"''Rooh. Or that's what they told me when I bought her.|Kallie Calwell and Ben Kenobi, about Rooh|<ref name="Kenobi novel" />}}
'''Rooh''' was an [[Eopie/Legends|eopie]] [[Gender|female]] that was owned by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. She helped save [[Kallie Calwell]] from a stampede of her [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]]. She gave birth to a [[Rooh's son|son]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. According to [[Annileen Calwell]], she was most likely pregnant when Kenobi purchased her, as eopies had a fairly long gestation period.<ref name="Kenobi novel" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rooh is named in the [[2014]] novel [[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']] by [[John Jackson Miller]]. The novel is set immediately following [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], and Rooh is Obi-Wan Kenobi's eopie from the beginning of ''Kenobi''.<ref name="Kenobi novel" /> Therefore, this article identifies the eopie seen in ''Revenge of the Sith'' with Rooh.
